stops.name: Cap Fréhel
stops.detail: Cap Fréhel is a peninsula in Côtes-d'Armor, in northern Brittany, France which extends off the Côte d'Émeraude into the Bay of Saint-Malo. The cape is 8.5 kilometres (5.3 miles) from the town centre of Fréhel. Administratively, it is in the territory of the commune of Plévenon.
